(1) “Prevention” refers to risk reduction of development of a condition. (2) “Management” refers most often to adjuvant use of the probiotic in the clinical management of the
condition, to improve signs and symptoms, not as sole o primary treatment. (3) “Others” refers to additional individual probiotics reported. (4) “Combinations” refers to positive
